headline: IOSCO Warns Financial Firms to Prepare for Advanced Quantum Computing Risks
summary: IOSCO warned that financial institutions and blockchains must begin a multi-year security overhaul as quantum computers grow highly advanced, though current systems cannot yet break existing cryptography.
why: IOSCO (International Organization of Securities Commissions) is the international body that brings together the world's securities regulators and sets global standards for the securities sector.
